auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    cl.location,
    cl.country,
    cl.lat,
    cl.lng
FROM CircuitLocation AS cl
JOIN CircuitDetails AS cd ON cl.circuitId = cd.circuitId
WHERE cd.name = 'Hungaroring'
